notes.title: Update 1.11
notes.notes: Small update with fixes for multiplayer and cloud regions.

notes.title: Update 1.1 with wheel loader, new languages and more
notes.notes:
- New vehicle: Kumato wheel loader added
- New language support for menu UI and subtitles: Spanish, French, Japanese
- Corrected mistakes in Level 3 building structure
- Improved online play inactivity warning

notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.notes:
Exact percentage of destroyed and cleaned up progress is now being displayed
 Input binding names regarding vehicles updated
 Fixed a problem with the "hydraulic hammer" achievement

notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.notes: Fixed a problem where previously saved jobs could not be continued later.

notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.notes:
Updated debris bucket functions, making it easier and faster to load debris with the excavator
 New logo design in store page and game menu

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.notes: Unlock the new Steam achievements in the game and share them in the community! The achievements are related to progress and challenges in game, but also to secrets hidden on the construction sites.

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.notes:
Added Steam achievements that you can unlock and share with the community!

In addition, all new players will receive a help display when first walking around and using the excavator.

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes:
- fixed bug when character stumbled and jackhammer or grinder couldn't be dropped
- menu UI: added hint about how to continue in a previously started job
